title: How a Smart Lock Works in 60 Seconds 🔐📱 #shorts
description:
A smart lock is still a normal deadbolt inside, but a tiny battery-powered motor turns it for you. Your phone sends an encrypted command over Bluetooth or Wi-Fi, and a circuit board checks it before the gears spin. Keypads, fingerprints and auto-lock add convenience, and most models keep a backup key. Follow Inside 60 for a new "how it works" explained in 60 seconds.

#smartlock #smarthome #howitworks

steps.label: Hook
steps.text: A smart lock runs on a few *AA batteries*, often for *six months to a year*.

steps.label: Deadbolt
steps.text: Inside the door it's a normal *deadbolt*. The bolt slides into the frame to lock.

steps.label: Motor
steps.text: A tiny *motor* spins reduction *gears* that turn the bolt, just like your hand would.

steps.label: Signal
steps.text: Your phone sends a command over *Bluetooth* or *Wi-Fi*, sometimes through a small bridge.

steps.label: Check
steps.text: The command is *encrypted*. A chip checks it's really you before the motor moves.

steps.label: Options
steps.text: A *keypad* or *fingerprint* also works, and *auto-lock* bolts the door after a set time.

steps.label: Recap
steps.text: Verify, spin, *lock*. Follow Inside 60 for more.
